title: AuditRun Institutional Chain
query: MATCH (a:AuditRun)-[:COMPARES]->(s:DeliveryStatus) OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[:PREVIOUS_STATUS*]->(old:DeliveryStatus) OPTIONAL MATCH (r:Recipient)-[:HAS_STATUS]->(s)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(inst) OPTIONAL MATCH (inst)-[:REFERENCES]->(u:LegalReference) RETURN a, s, old, r, inst, u
